findings.title: M3_R10 and R10_VALIDATION say R150-R155 are still missing from the plate tool's strain table; they have been in STRAIN_PARTS since round 19
findings.contradicts: tools/plate_model.py STRAIN_PARTS (line 40: 'R150', 'R151', 'R152', 'R153', 'R154', 'R155', comment R18-MEC-01) and R10_DECISIONS.md line 3199 ('STRAIN_PARTS (R18-MEC-01). R150-R155 are added (NumPy test)'); added in commit 2ca63a1 (round 19 gate pass).
findings.evidence: docs/M3_R10.md line 874: 'The gate pass added J410, J420, J9, J400, C431, C421 and C411 to the plate tool's table; R150-R155 are still missing (open Minor)'. docs/R10_VALIDATION.md line 2709: '... the gate lane added J410, J420, J9, J400, C431, C421 and C411 to the tool's table, R150-R155 are still missing'. Running tools/plate_model.py --profile r10 on this board's fit report (.supervisor/r25_mechanics/plate.json) reports strain for R150 1382, R151 1420, R152 1391, R153 1337, R154 1359, R155 1336 microstrain (100 g, D5 pinned).
findings.impact: Two records state an open gap in the plate tool that does not exist; a reader would think the servo resistors' strain is unreported and open.
findings.concrete_fix: In both places replace 'R150-R155 are still missing (open Minor)' with 'R150-R155 were added in the round 19 gate pass (R10_DECISIONS R18-MEC-01 line)'. Optionally quote the 92c3ad59 values from this run (R150-R155 1336-1420 microstrain, D5 pinned, Calculation/Inference).

findings.title: ORDERING 8.4: '4.5 mm standoffs with a plate <= 0.8 mm (keeps h + t < 5.3 mm at x 3.7)' allows h + t = 5.3 mm, which is not below the stated 5.3 mm bound
findings.contradicts: docs/M3_R10.md line 857 ('Nut-inclusive combined h + t bounds remain strictly below 6.0 mm at x = 4 and 42 and below 5.3 mm at x = 3.7'), line 911 ('Use conservative combined limits h + t < 6.0 / 5.3 mm'), R10_VEHICLE_HANDOFF line 76 and R10_VALIDATION line 2938 ('<5.3 mm at x 3.7').
findings.evidence: docs/ORDERING.md line 699, Landing clause: '4.5 mm standoffs with a plate <= 0.8 mm (keeps h + t < 5.3 mm at x 3.7)'. At the permitted maximum, h + t = 4.5 + 0.8 = 5.3 mm, which equals rather than stays below 5.3 mm. The same option is given in REQUIREMENTS P3 (line 74), R10_VEHICLE_HANDOFF line 105 and R10_VALIDATION row 32 (line 2171). Recomputed: the exact nut-stack bound at x = 3.7 is sqrt(24.9^2 - 22.775^2) - 4.7 = 5.3653 mm (M3_R10 line 911), so 5.3 mm fits physically; the false part is the stated '< 5.3' and the conflict with the strict rule.
findings.impact: The documented vehicle option breaks the documents' own strict h + t limit at its upper end; a builder following both cannot satisfy them at plate = 0.8 mm.
findings.concrete_fix: Either write 'a plate < 0.8 mm' in the four places, or state the bound as h + t <= 5.3 mm (exact limit 5.365 mm, M3_R10) and change 'keeps h + t < 5.3 mm' to 'keeps h + t <= 5.3 mm, inside the 5.365 mm bound'.

observations: R10_VALIDATION row 32 (line 2171) says the 98-163 g landing range is 'above the 125 g' C431 contact figure; only its upper part is above (ORDERING 699 correctly says 'can exceed'); and C421's contact is 132-133 g, not 125 g. Wording; the conclusion and the vehicle item stand.

At 4 mm standoffs the plate model (D5 pinned, this board) puts J9's terminal-tail allocations onto the sled at 162-167 g and J420.1's at 167 g, before C411 (174 g) and L1 (213 g); ORDERING 699's contact list omits them, but they are inside the x 31.5-41 / y 20-60 relief pocket and clear to 207 g at 4.5 mm standoffs, so the vehicle item covers them (round 24 noted the same tails as gaps).
Wire room (fit_check wire_rooms) applies the 0.3 mm sled tolerance horizontally only; that is the documented definition (P2, R18-MEC-03), not an error.

Plate model on 92c3ad59 reproduces the records exactly: 180.8 Hz pinned D5, 78.6 g; also 255.6 / 287.8 / 407.0 Hz and 1.27 mm at (46, 44.5). The records' 256.1 / 287.9 / 407.1 Hz and 1.24 mm are explicitly labelled as 632a9ad3 figures; the same current-tool numbers come out on 5516eeec and 1407e850, so D402's mass effect is nil as the records infer.
C431 / C421 100 g gap at 4 mm: 0.257 / 0.318 mm on a 0.1 mm raster vs the recorded 0.261 / 0.320 mm (raster resolution only).
Copper on all four layers stops 0.50 mm from every Ø3.2 mm support hole edge (2.1 mm from centre); no copper or part enters any support keep-out beyond the recorded LED2.2 3.808 mm top-land case.
M3_R10 line 870-875 still says the plate calculation 'has not been re-run on the current board' for the R18-MEC-01 strain values; that is a disclosed historical attribution, not a false figure.
